formula_recommendations.title: Accounting and taxes
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Q=sum(disjoint gross expense lines); exclusive gross=round(q*r*(1+t/100)); inclusive gross=round(q*r), net=round(q*r/(1+t/100))
formula_recommendations.purpose: Dimensional/accounting reconciliation prevents bundle and reserve double counting.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: All quantity/rate/tax cards; tax_scope; included_items; accounting boundary
formula_recommendations.limitations: Tax and compound service charges, single-level inclusion map, deposits and rounding need review
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Confirm one accounting boundary and unknown taxes. Excluded components are not provider bundles. No fabricated zero VAT.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: Total cost = sum(disjoint expense lines); reserve excluded from expenses.

formula_recommendations.title: Paid duration
formula_recommendations.purpose: Separates scheduled span from measured/paid hours.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Actual paid breaks, role scope and overtime agreement missing. Date span is not paid duration; direct hour/overtime boundary checks added in Stage 2 verification
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: H>0; Hsetup,Hclear>=0; archetype-specific bounds UNSET. Date span is not event hours.

formula_recommendations.title: Seating and furniture demand
formula_recommendations.purpose: Preserves integer resource requirements and dependent quantities.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Single table capacity for VIP and standard tables must fit plan. Seat share is A008, guest occupancy is A005
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.

formula_recommendations.title: Usable venue area
formula_recommendations.purpose: Avoids substituting capacity for physical measurement.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Need measured plan; capacity is not floor area
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: U=V-excluded_area; 0<U<=V; V and excluded-area bounds UNSET.

formula_recommendations.title: Area allocation
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Standard=(N-VIP)*a_standard; VIP_area=VIP*a_vip; non-overlapping service and circulation areas
formula_recommendations.purpose: Dimensionally consistent allocation without inventing venue standards.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Densities/circulation not observed. No fire-safety certification
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept only as a hypothetical non-overlapping area model; no measured density, egress or fire-safety claim.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: Seating_area=(N-NVIP)*a_seat; VIP_area=NVIP*a_VIP; a_seat,a_VIP>0, numeric bounds UNSET.

formula_recommendations.title: Stage and independent package steps
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: S=width*length; separately choose AV and lighting units from first reviewed max_stage_area_m2>=S
formula_recommendations.purpose: Models possible stepwise resource changes rather than an unobserved fitted correlation.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: stage_width_m; stage_length_m; av_steps; lighting_steps; scoped kit rates
formula_recommendations.limitations: Legacy register/R03 uses ceil-area expression; amended engine uses independent steps. Zero stage is accepted by engine, but original positive-dimension scope needs a decision
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Retire legacy ceil-area AV expression; use separate explicit package steps. Lighting off by scope, not free vendor service.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: S=width*length; positive approved dimension bounds UNSET; kit count=base+ceil(S/area_per_kit).

formula_recommendations.title: Spatial constraints
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: guest_count; capacity_persons; usable area; seating/stage/service/circulation areas
formula_recommendations.limitations: No automatic layout adaptation. Invalid layout blocks; if N<G no standing-person area is explicitly allocated. Restrict review POC to N=G until amendment
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Allow explicitly hypothetical geometry only after a versioned reviewed adapter change, or supply measured reviewed geometry.

formula_recommendations.title: Package catering
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Catering quantity=planned G; charge G*approved per-person package rate once, subject to reviewed inclusion map
formula_recommendations.purpose: Resource accounting makes guest-to-food dependency transparent.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: guest_count; package catering rate/tax; inclusion map
formula_recommendations.limitations: No ingredient BOM, wastage, minimum guests or adult/child tiers implemented. Quotes requiring these are not compatible without amendments
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Use package-only; no ingredient BOM. Obtain compatible standalone package quote; reject double charging unitemized meeting bundles.

formula_recommendations.title: Disjoint equipment ledger
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Chairs=N; tables from A008; stage=S; other equipment fixed booking line; each applicable line charged once
formula_recommendations.purpose: Connects seating demand to quantities and avoids bundle duplication.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: seats; tables; stage area; equipment rates/taxes; reviewed scope/inclusion map
formula_recommendations.limitations: Item-day rates need duration conversion. Equipment aggregate is not a single podium price
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Add a reviewed explicit component-exclusion mechanism before live use. Do not forge inclusion maps to waive missing rates.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: chair_qty*chair_rate+table_qty*table_rate+explicit delivery; bundled items charged zero only when inclusion is established.

formula_recommendations.title: General staff and billing hours
formula_recommendations.purpose: Maintains dependencies and units; avoids random independent staff/cost columns.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: base_staff; guest_count; guests_per_staff; extra_general_staff; paid hours; overtime_multiplier; labour rate
formula_recommendations.limitations: General pool excludes vendor/security staff. Formula implies at least one ratio-based staff member when G>0; all-staff-bundled cases need a scope amendment
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Restricted general staff only; policy ratios/hours are hypothetical, not measured wages or legal overtime.

formula_recommendations.title: Venue billing
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Venue=approved fixed booking amount + Hevent*approved hourly tariff; each line normalized for tax
formula_recommendations.purpose: Supports costs while preventing a false observed capacity-price correlation.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: venue_fixed rate; venue_hourly rate; event_hours; tax scope; booking window
formula_recommendations.limitations: Current formula bills all event hours. Included-hour and clock-time surcharges do not fit without a reviewed extension
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Pilot proposes fixed one-booking charge; hourly component off. Need actual scoped booking price; do not transfer another venue tariff to invented geometry.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: rent=fixed_fee+billable_hours*hourly_rate+explicit extras; alternatively approved area tariff, not both without scope.

formula_recommendations.title: Budget constraint
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: B fixed before outcomes; reserve=c*Q; require B>=reserve; planned breaches compare Q>B and Q>B-reserve
formula_recommendations.purpose: Preserves ex-ante constraint and includes financially stressed cases.
formula_recommendations.limitations: If experimental B=b*Qreference is selected, calculate once for baseline and freeze for What-If pairs. Never recalculate B from realized cost
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: B=approved independent budget or b*Q; proposed b stress interval [.85,1.30], not population estimate; B>=Reserve.

formula_recommendations.title: Retained receipts and profit
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Planned profit=expected retained receipts-Q; realized profit=realized retained receipts-realized cost
formula_recommendations.purpose: Allows loss/profit outcomes without forcing expected revenue to match actual costs.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Do not equate client total turnover or pass-through cash with retained receipts. No receipt amount inferred from desired profit
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: Contract: approved retained fee. Ticketed: planned attendees*ticket_rate+retained booth/sponsor receipts. Values UNSET.

formula_recommendations.title: Margin policy
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Margin_points=100*profit/receipts when receipts>0; compare to separately selected minimum_margin_points
formula_recommendations.purpose: Labels have explicit business-policy meaning and auditable boundaries.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Zero receipts gives null margin, not a safe zero-risk label. Policy threshold is not industry average
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: Proposed stress policies 10%,20%,30%; stored as 10,20,30 percentage points. Not industry averages.

formula_recommendations.title: Contingency funding
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Reserve=round(c*Q); operating allowance=B-Reserve; Reserve excluded from Q and profit expenses
formula_recommendations.purpose: Avoids double counting reserve and exposes policy sensitivity.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Unspent reserve is funding, not expense. Reserve fraction does not represent a calibrated confidence level
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: Reserve=c*Q; proposed c stress policies .05,.10,.15,.20; alternative pre-event quantile requires approved shock model.

formula_recommendations.title: Planning estimate
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Forecasted_Total_Cost=Q for this provisional deterministic POC; historical event mean/vendor volatility remain null
formula_recommendations.purpose: Prevents replacing event history with ingredient or contract aggregates.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: disjoint planned ledger; reviewed rates, quantities and taxes
formula_recommendations.limitations: No Prophet forecast or trained-model prediction. Retail history cannot replace observed event outcomes
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: Forecast=approved planning-rule estimate initially; historical event mean/vendor volatility NULL without defined comparable history.

formula_recommendations.title: Budget outcome label
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Budget_Overrun=1[round(realized cost)>round(B)] if valid nonnegative operands; equality=0
formula_recommendations.purpose: Transparent financial boundary with no outcome input leakage.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: realized total cost; fixed ex-ante initial_budget_lkr; rounding convention
formula_recommendations.limitations: Actual outcomes unavailable. Future synthetic labels require origin and frozen ex-ante budget; planned flag is not target
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: 1[C_sim>B], equality=0; missing when inputs invalid; label origin simulated.

formula_recommendations.title: Margin outcome label
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Profit_Margin_Risk=1[100*(realized receipts-realized cost)/realized receipts < required margin]; receipts<=0 => null
formula_recommendations.purpose: Avoids false finite margins and incorrect zero labels.
formula_recommendations.limitations: Tested arithmetic does not validate market outcomes. Outcome and injected flags excluded from planning features
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Accept definition in restricted simulator scope; numerical calibration and genuine review remain separate.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: margin=100*(R_sim-C_sim)/R_sim; target=1[margin<m_required]; R_sim<=0 or missing => target missing.

formula_recommendations.title: Version and identity binding
formula_recommendations.actual_formula: Engine fingerprint=SHA256(sorted compact JSON); parameter payload includes parameters/rates/billing/steps/override bounds; pilot binds full configuration and count
formula_recommendations.purpose: Makes scenario construction and interventions reproducible/auditable.
formula_recommendations.required_inputs: exact payloads; source/code/runtime/seed/rule versions; exact authorized count
formula_recommendations.limitations: Draft hashes identify content, not completeness, signatures or permission. Seed/RNG/source cutoff remain unresolved
formula_recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Keep fingerprints separate from signatures/completeness. Reviewed geometry/exclusion changes require new code/rule/hash approval.
formula_recommendations.original_register_formula: Stable SYN/SYNBASE IDs; Is_Augmented=1; independent recorded RNG streams; paired what-if common random draws.
